program.ge_pattern: Columbia College General Education (CC-GE) Pattern or California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC) Pattern
outcomes: Demonstrate basic knowledge of fundamental theories associated with physical education, fitness, and sport programs.
Demonstrate the ability to critically analyze issues and trends in sport psychology, sport in society, and the emerging professions associated with sport, fitness and injury prevention in sport.

notes: Group I and Group II sit under an 'Electives' heading (Total 7 units; complete 7 units), recorded as two separate choose_units blocks of 3 and 4 units.
Degree total of 60 taken from the page header '19.0 Major Units | 60 Total Units Required'; no GE unit figure is printed.
The student completes one of two GE patterns (CC-GE or Cal-GETC); both are named in ge_pattern.
Codes are printed without a space in the catalog (e.g., HHP3); they match closed-list codes such as HHP 3.

An outcomes lead-in also appears near the top of the page with no outcomes under it; the outcomes were taken from the Program Learning Outcomes section. The second outcome's line break was read as a space.
